text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're on the bus bound for summer camp, but Tamamo Cross is a nervous wreck. It seems the cars speeding past the bus have her thinking about potential traffic accidents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I console her as best I can, and we vow to overcome her anxiety together by the end of the camp.
